Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

A professor and a bartender each showed up early to drop their kids off at daycare today. It's easy to tell that the bartender has a close relationship with their kid based on how they hugged each other goodbye, but the professor just seemed to push the kid out the door, and the kid didn't seem surprised by this at all. Who is an inattentive parent?
A. The professor
B. Not enough information
C. The bartender
